build_cherry_blossoms_dataset: build a TensorFlow DatasetBuilder for historical cherry blossom flowering data at Kyoto City
create_cherry_blossoms_builder: create a CherryBlossoms dataset builder that downloads and parses CSV data from a remote URL
test_cherry_blossoms_info: test the CherryBlossoms dataset builder metadata including features, description, and citation
run_cherry_blossoms_download: run the CherryBlossoms dataset builder to download CSV data and generate train split examples
review_cherry_blossoms_examples: review the CherryBlossoms _generate_examples method that parses semicolon-delimited CSV rows into feature dictionaries
